text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy keeps her promise. She<n>doesn't bite
anyone, and she even<n>performs better than in her
debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the spectators were more<n>interested in
whether she'd bite<n>again rather than her running.
She's<n>left feeling frustrated that her talent<n>has gone
unacknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I commend her for having run well.<n>Today, she's
won a battle against<n>herself, and now she stirs with
courage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to prove that she's neither<n>a coward nor
a cheat, and restore her<n>tarnished reputation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to change public perception<n>of her, she'll
need to show off her<n>true skill on an even bigger
stage. We<n>make her next objective the Japan<n>Dirt
Derby, a G1 race.
